The target [8, 0, 1] is the centroid of the 4-stair cluster placed at (8,0,0), (8,0,1), (8,0,2), and (9,0,1). max_distance=16 allows triggering from the building entrance or inside while facing the stairs. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is genuinely looking toward the stairs, not just nearby. scene_description: A small stone brick building containing polished diorite stairs is placed ~8 blocks east of spawn. Two decoy structures (oak planks with oak stairs, cobblestone with stone stairs) are placed in opposite corners to add navigation challenge. The player must identify and enter the correct building to find the polished diorite stairs.
